page_title: SEV 1-4 BAR | Sevilla v Barcelona 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Suso (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+3' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Alejandro Hernandez sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+1' The goal for Barcelona is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 4 Eric Garcia (Barcelona) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:4.
89' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Lamine Yamal is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcao (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' That will be all from Adria Pedrosa who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marcao (Sevilla).
85' Suso (Sevilla) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Wojciech Szczesny makes a save.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' Loic Bade (Sevilla) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
79' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Loic Bade (Sevilla) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save. Sevilla win a corner.
76' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Saul Niguez will be replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch for Nemanja Gudelj.
75' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle as Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
73' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
71' Here is a change. Frenkie de Jong is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
71' The substitution has been made. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has replaced Robert Lewandowski.
69' The attendance is 38592.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Loic Bade (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Pedri (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

64' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Orjan Nyland makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
63' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replaces Ruben Vargas.
63' Here comes a substitution. Djibril Sow is given a rest as he is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
62' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) has to leave the pitch!
61' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Fermin Lopez (Barcelona)! Let's see what he decides.
60' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
59' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.

55' 1 - 3 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Orjan Nyland had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:3.
54' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
51' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
50' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Raphinha (Barcelona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
49' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

46' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes it 1:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Pedri and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Orjan Nyland was helpless.
46' The game is over for Gavi (Barcelona). Fermin Lopez comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

45+1' Wojciech Szczesny makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
44' Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
43' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
42' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) controls a great pass from Lamine Yamal on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

39' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gavi (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
35' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) commits a foul during an attacking move.
33' Gavi (Barcelona) commits a foul and Alejandro Hernandez immediately signals a free kick.
33' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
29' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
26' Barcelona are ruled offside.
25' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Good movement by Isaac Romero (Sevilla), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
22' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) is substituted due to injury. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Pau Cubarsi.
17' The game is interrupted now, Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Saul Niguez (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
16' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Raphinha (Barcelona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Orjan Nyland easily deals with the threat.
15' Barcelona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' An attempted cross from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is cleared.
11' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Barcelona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' 1 - 1 Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
7' 0 - 1 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the middle of the goal.
7' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Orjan Nyland, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
4' A pass from Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny and the move breaks down.
2' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
2' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
2' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
